_readme: Small config the agent reads/writes each run. artifactUrl is filled in after the first successful publish and must be reused (not regenerated) on every subsequent run so updates land on the same page instead of creating a new one each day.
pagesPublishScope: every run — uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if set (scheduled cloud runs), else the local gh CLI
lastRunStatus: Weekly research run: no new opportunities founded (Product Management/QA/Data Engineering/Help Desk searches all came back short of the reliability≥3 bar for founding evidence, or fell outside the 12-month window). First-ever searches of U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and Federal Reserve Bank of New York both yielded: BEA papers enrich genai-adoption-plateau-scaling-gap (already at ceiling, score unchanged at 5) and contradict ai-productivity-reallocated-not-cut (strength 3, below trail-best, no score change, still 3); NY Fed pieces enrich ai-productivity-reallocated-not-cut and add a third contradicting-evidence row to entry-level-hiring-contraction-mixed-evidence (score unchanged at 4, still contested). A Census Bureau QWI working paper (Tucker, April 2026) adds quasi-experimental corroboration to entry-level-hiring-contraction-mixed-evidence. A peer-reviewed Wharton study (Tambe, Management Science) adds a second institution to oecd-ai-skill-demand-shifts-management-business-skills, moving corroborationBreadth 2→3 with composite unchanged at 4. Red-teamed this run: all ten evidenceScore≥4 opportunities; only entry-level-hiring-contraction-mixed-evidence produced a new threshold-clearing contradiction, and it did not change the score (already below the supporting trail's strength). Four sources crossed consecutiveEmptyRuns≥6 this run, all incrementing further (HBR 7, NBER 7, BCG 7, IDC 7) — still reads as a quiet-week artifact given how heavily each is cited elsewhere, but the streak now warrants a deeper per-institution search next run. Both the Claude Artifact and the GitHub Pages mirror published successfully (publish_pages.py and --verify both exited 0).
pagesTokenPermissions: fine-grained PAT, repository access limited to sdm1130/ai-it-research-tracker, Contents: Read and write (Metadata: Read-only is added automatically). Nothing else required: main has no branch protection or rulesets, and Pages is build_type=legacy on main:/ so it rebuilds on push.

pagesPublishExitCodes.3: no credentials — skip and report mirror stale
pagesPublishExitCodes.1: real failure e.g. expired token — report loudly
